# PowerLink v0.3.1 — PowerShuffle dashboard controls

This Home Assistant integration update adds **PowerShuffle start/resume from
the Home Assistant dashboard**. It works with the existing **PowerPlay
1.4.0 APK**; no Fire TV app rebuild is required.

## Changes

- Add `powerlink.powershuffle_launch`: select a previously tracked show and
  a registered destination, then start its next eligible episode in the
  existing PowerPlay PowerLink receiver. If the same show is already playing
  in another room, automatically use the verified handoff path.
- Accept `show_entity` and `destination_entity` to reuse existing Home
  Assistant `input_select` helpers without creating additional scripts.
- Keep PowerShuffle rotation history, five-day cooldowns and Plex profile
  isolation intact. Ambiguous profiles, untracked shows and exhausted queues
  are rejected with explicit errors.
- Add a bounded `PowerLink PowerShuffle Library` sensor with tracked-show
  summaries for dashboards, alongside the original per-show sensors.
- Avoid sending an unnecessary source-pause command for a cold launch
  originating in Home Assistant.
- Preserve configured destination wake routines, including protected
  power-on scripts, and all existing PowerLink handoff behavior.

## Compatibility

Requires PowerPlay **1.4.0+** for PowerShuffle (no APK changes). Existing
PowerLink v1 queue transfers remain compatible with earlier tested builds.

## Usage

After installing in HACS and restarting Home Assistant, use:

```yaml
action: powerlink.powershuffle_launch
data:
  show_entity: input_select.plezy_shuffle_show
  destination_entity: input_select.plezy_shuffle_fire_tv
```

The selected show must have been launched at least once with PowerShuffle
in PowerPlay so Home Assistant has its episode inventory. See the
[PowerLink README](https://github.com/The-Power-0/PowerLink#start-powershuffle-directly-from-home-assistant-031)
for explicit show/profile examples.
